# ankra_service_consumer (Resource)

A consumer binding: one application's namespace on one cluster that managed services may be set up for. The counterpart of `ankra services consumers bind` and `unbind`; its id is what `ankra services setup --consumer` takes.

A binding that a live service still uses cannot be removed until that service is retired, so destroy fails with a 409 until then. The platform does not return `allow_planned`, so a change to it made outside Terraform is not detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_service_consumer" "orders" {
  application_id = "3c2b1a0f-9e8d-4c7b-a6f5-e4d3c2b1a0f9"
  cluster_id     = "9f4c2d1e-5a6b-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f"
  namespace      = "orders"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application that consumes services. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the namespace is on. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the application on the cluster. Changing it replaces the binding.

### Optional

- `allow_planned` (Boolean) Bind a namespace the application is not installed in yet. Defaults to `false`, which requires the installation to exist.
- `local_only` (Boolean) Whether the consumer may use only services on its own cluster. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `binding_kind` (String) Whether the binding resolved to an installation or is planned.
- `binding_revision` (Number) Revision of the binding; every change increases it.
- `data_boundary` (String) Data boundary resolved from the cluster's placement policy.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the binding (the consumer id).
- `installation_id` (String) Application installation the binding resolved to; null for a planned binding.
- `region` (String) Region resolved from the cluster's placement policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Consumer bindings are imported by consumer id (ankra services consumers list).
terraform import ankra_service_consumer.orders 6a5b4c3d-2e1f-4a0b-9c8d-7e6f5a4b3c2d
```
